large_unit: derive evidence-aware distinction between productive ceiling and operating cutoff
finding: PRODUCTIVE_CAP is an empirical envelope, while SOFT_CUTOFF is a policy decision. A P3/P4 admission policy can have no single task-start cutoff; instead the admissible frontier is hard_cap - reserve - estimated_task_duration. Therefore final reporting should preserve both a scalar conservative cutoff (for simple fallback) and the task-size-dependent admission frontier if P3/P4 wins.
fallback_candidate: If policy simplicity is required before enough estimation data exist, use a conservative scalar cutoff derived from worst representative task size rather than the shortest task size.
